استشكلا (form X)

# اُسْتُشْكِلَا (ustuškilā) /us.tuʃ.ki.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكِلَا (istaškilā) /is.taʃ.ki.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
